messages.content: Write a short scene in modern American English about Tiffany and Maya walking home together after school. Keep their established character details consistent. Tiffany has long curly dark red hair and green eyes. Maya has shoulder-length dark brown hair and brown eyes. They are longtime best friends who have known each other since they were babies. Do not change their appearances, invent different backgrounds, or introduce other characters. Keep the scene focused on their friendship and ordinary conversation.

Tiffany pushed a curl of dark red hair away from her face as she walked, the afternoon breeze catching it again almost immediately.

Maya smiled. “You know your hair is fighting you.”

“I've noticed.” Tiffany tried tucking it behind one ear. “It's been fighting me since first period.”

Maya adjusted the strap of her bag and glanced over at her. Her dark brown hair brushed her shoulders as she walked.

“You could cut it.”

Tiffany stopped for half a second and stared at her. “Take that back.”

“I knew you'd say that.”

“I'm not giving up this hair just because it has a personal grudge against me.”

Maya laughed. “Fair.”

They kept walking, falling back into the same easy rhythm they'd had for years.

“Remember when we used to get mad at each other over stupid stuff?” Tiffany asked.

“Used to?”

Tiffany laughed. “Okay. Fair point.”

“We've known each other way too long for you to pretend you're suddenly mature.”

“I'm very mature.”

“Sure.”

Tiffany bumped her shoulder against Maya's. “You know, you're supposed to support me.”

“I am supporting you. I'm supporting your commitment to being ridiculous.”

Tiffany grinned. “See? That's why you're my best friend.”

Maya shook her head, smiling as they continued along the sidewalk together.”
